note: Both sets are heavily redundant, repeating the 96.00 oz starting-water minimum and the Figure 9 thresholds several times. Set A additionally captures the reduced-points range (16–80 oz vaporized), a key scoring fact that Set B omits entirely, and its quotes are generally supported. However, Set A misstates the single-container condition as 'vaporized in a single task' and includes a fragmentary quote '(2.721 kg)', while Set B is cleaner with fuller quotes but incomplete coverage. On balance Set A covers more of the page's engineering content despite one misread.
